teenKit.tldr: Clockwork Manifolds or Fractal Storms? (Neural Population Dynamics, Cortical Subspaces, and High-Dimensional Coding on Trial — From Sherrington, Hubel-Wiesel & Georgopoulos's cosine-tuned single neurons to Computation Through Dynamics; Churchland & Shenoy's 2012 jPCA reaching rotations & Kaufman's output-null preparatory subspaces; Sadtler, Yu & Batista's 2014 closed-loop BCI proof of intrinsic manifold learning barriers & Gardner-Moser's 2022 Neuropixels 3D toroidal grid-cell attractor; Stringer, Pachitariu & Harris's 10,000-neuron V1 1/n smooth power-law spectrum, Jazayeri & Ostojic's intrinsic vs. embedding dimensionality & Lebedev's latency-sequence critique): For more than half a century, systems neuroscience treated individual cortical neurons like static feature detectors or miniature speedometers—firing in proportion to bar orientation in visual cortex .
